from_quote: In the proposed system the general government has a power not only without the consent, but contrary to the will of the state government, to call out the whole of its militia
rationale: The paragraph names the power in the proposed system to "call out" a state's militia, which only the militia-calling clause of Article I, Section 8 fits.

from_quote: It has also, by another clause, the powers by which only the militia can be organized and armed
rationale: The paragraph names "another clause" giving the powers by which the militia "can be organized and armed", which only the clause on organizing, arming and disciplining the militia fits.
